description: This file implements two classes for interacting with Neuphonic's Text-to-Speech services: 'NeuphonicTTSService' using WebSocket API for real-time streaming and 'NeuphonicHttpTTSService' using HTTP with server-sent events for batch streaming. The code includes functions for language code conversion, connection management, message processing, and TTS generation, supporting both real-time and HTTP-based synthesis workflows.

classes.name: NeuphonicTTSService
classes.description: A WebSocket-based real-time TTS service integrating with Neuphonic's API, supporting speech synthesis streaming, connection management, interruption, and real-time frame processing.

classes.name: NeuphonicHttpTTSService
classes.description: An HTTP-based TTS implementation for Neuphonic, utilizing server-sent events for streaming synthesized audio and supporting configurable parameters.
